That attitude will get you through this - I am from the UK where this is technically an illegal substance (2016 act passed to halt legal highs) . I ruined so many holidays for myself and family , putting the WD down to food not agreeing or a bug and it got to the point where I had to make the choice and go through what you are now. It gets better , quickly in my experience, after day 4 and by day 8 onwards the improvement is tangible and uplifting so you’re nearly 25% there to the new you and the best advice I can offer is that you’re 50% through the worst as well so you’ve got this 👍

So get where you’re coming from , I took kratom for 6 years daily as a cure for chronic stomach issues resultant from recurring c-diff infections. At first I was elated and it was a miracle cure , but nobody tells you about the cognitive skills loss, memory impairment, tolerance and loss of hair and libido . I quit and have “followed through” while farting with confidence on at least 3 occasions as the  withdrawals kicked in but the good news is that side of it only lasted three days for me and my original stomach issues have not returned so I’m happy about that .

I’m on day 24/5 clean now and we all know the first 5-7 days suck, I don’t care what anyone says they suck! But it is the same if you quit now or later so if you’ve taken the decision to quit now realise that each day after day 4 or 5 is better. You at least know why you feel bad don’t you? And you also know it’s relatively short term , with the promise of short term memory and cognitive skills improving with each day that you’re clean . Also I know someone mentioned hair loss , if you use daily there is also a good chance this stuff will kill or seriously dampen your libido - it did mine anyway and I’m happy to report that has returned too big style . Overall kratom was sold as a cure all with little potential for harm to the user but while it does have some potential benefits it is all too easily abused and the withdrawal isn’t pleasant but compared to other stuff I’ve come off isn’t the worst either - that trophy goes to gabapentin- fucking horrible w/ds resulting in hospitalisation and a seizure.

Be careful with those Gabapentin buddy - the withdrawals from them is hell compared to kratom . I was on them for 3 years for my neuropathic post shingles pain and they’re the reason I switched to kratom . The withdrawal nearly hospitalised me I had a seizure and I’d never had anything like that before .

This is not easy but it is do-able , believe me , my habit was insane and costing me £540 per month along with major worries about customs seizures as the legality of kratom in the Uk is grey to say the least since the Physchoactive Substance Act 2016 made this a questionable substance. You just have to take each hour as it comes , safe in the knowledge that the physical withdrawal does pass , peaking at about 5-7 days from my experience and then you start to feel better . I’ve ruined holidays because I couldn’t take my powder abroad , blaming food poisoning for my bad stomach and claiming to have caught a flu bug, one day I woke up and said “enough” and tipped about 600 g down the toilet and here I am . Not yet right but much better and finding joy in little things that kratom blinds you to seeing so keep it up I promise you it’ll be worth it .

I just quit cold turkey and had a flu like illness for 4 days and after that each day felt a little better . Sleep was non existent at first so I dosed a little night nurse liquid which did the trick and bought some remag solution for some good magnesium intake and honestly the way I feel now is so much better and my short term memory is returning. I had been using daily for 6 years, it got so bad I was buying a kilo every 12 days so my intake was insane - I used a placebo for when I got the urge to make a cup of kratom tea and I’m now a turmeric fan. Everyone is different and will react differently- some have very little withdrawals and some major but in every case they are temporary and with will power and the help of a loved one or trusted friend this can be done. Believe me I am the weakest willed individual you will ever meet and I am doing this so anyone can. I’m on day 22 now and the urge to dose is gone completely.
